# TopEdge, WhatsApp automation for Shopify ecommerce (India)
# https://topedgeai.com
# Last updated: 2026-09-08

> TopEdge is a WhatsApp automation and cart recovery platform for Shopify D2C brands in India. Connect Shopify + Meta WhatsApp Cloud API to run abandoned cart recovery, COD confirmations, shared inbox, journeys, and Meta-safe campaigns.

## Product
- WhatsApp automation for Shopify
- Abandoned cart recovery on WhatsApp
- COD confirmation / RTO reduction
- Ecommerce automation (journeys, order updates)
- Shopify WhatsApp integration (OAuth sync)
- Shared WhatsApp + Instagram inbox with order context
- Meta WhatsApp template manager (Cloud API)
- Agency multi-brand WhatsApp ops
